concept.title: Membership, fees and contact
concept.shortdesc: Practical conditions for joining in, such as paying a fee, becoming a member, or contacting the service before attending.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : A joining, membership, subscription or other fee that has to be paid to take part.
: Needing to get in touch with the service first to enquire, check eligibility, discuss needs, or arrange a visit.
: Needing to be, or become, a member of the group or club to take part.
: Having a disability, impairment, medical condition or specific diagnosis to qualify.
: Expecting a certain level of previous experience or qualification, or restricting to beginners.
